name: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop')
principle: A loop depends on state that never changes or can never satisfy the exit test, so termination is unreachable. This can pin a thread, burn CPU or memory, and create a denial of service.
detection_signals: `while`/`do-while`/`for(;;)` where the loop condition references a variable never assigned in the body
loop exit depends on a function call whose return value is not checked with any timeout, limit, or progress test
body contains only `continue`/`sleep`/retry logic and no mutation of the terminating variable
condition variable is initialized before the loop but never updated inside all paths of the loop
loop repeats on external state like `connect()`, `read()`, `recv()`, or `poll()` with no attempt counter or deadline
`while (x > 0)` / `while (x < limit)` where `x` is only read, not decremented/incremented toward exit
negative_signals: loop counter incremented and compared against a hard limit, e.g. `count++` plus `count < MAX_ATTEMPTS`
terminating variable is updated each iteration toward the exit condition, e.g. `inventoryCount -= rateSold` with validated positive `rateSold`
loop guarded by a timeout/deadline check, e.g. `System.nanoTime() < deadline` or `time(NULL) < end_time`
explicit `break`, `return`, or `throw` on failed progress or repeated failure
input validation rejects zero/negative step values that would prevent progress
bounded iteration API used, e.g. `for (i = 0; i < n; i++)` with finite `n`
false_defense_traps: `sleep()` or backoff inside the loop without a hard retry cap
logging the failure condition but still re-entering the same loop
retrying inside `catch` without changing state or limiting attempts
checking the exit condition only after the body when the body can never update the state
using a mutable external flag that is never written on all paths
verification_focus: Can every loop path actually change the variables used by the exit test or hit a hard bound/deadline?

consequence_chains.trigger: the endless loop consumes CPU, memory, or retries without bound
consequence_chains.consequence: service hang or denial of service due to resource exhaustion

patch_principle: Add a hard iteration limit or timeout to every retry loop
Ensure each loop path mutates the exit-state variable toward termination
Validate inputs that control loop progress, such as step size, divisor, or decrement
Fail fast when progress cannot be made instead of retrying forever
Use blocking/network APIs with explicit deadlines or cancellation

minimal_examples.vuln: do { connected = connect(sock, addr, len); } while (connected < 0);
minimal_examples.safe: do { connected = connect(sock, addr, len); count++; } while (connected < 0 && count < MAX_ATTEMPTS);
